# CSS and SCSS in Quarto

## What is CSS?

CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to control the appearance of a website, including colors, fonts, spacing, and layout.

CSS helps make Quarto websites more attractive, professional, and user-friendly.

## What is SCSS?

SCSS (Sassy CSS) is an extension of CSS that supports additional features such as variables, nesting, and reusable styles.

SCSS makes it easier to organize and maintain website styling.

## How CSS Can Improve My Portfolio

CSS can help me:

-   Customize website colors and backgrounds.
-   Improve text readability.
-   Adjust spacing and page layouts.
-   Make my portfolio more professional.

## Example: CSS Styling

``` css
h1 {
  color: #174A67;
  font-size: 32px;
}

body {
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
```

## Example: SCSS Variables

``` scss
$primary-color: #174A67;

h1 {
  color: $primary-color;
}
```

## Conclusion

CSS and SCSS are useful tools for customizing Quarto websites. They allow me to create a consistent visual identity and improve the user experience of my digital marketing portfolio.
